title: Summer Vacation
intro: [excited] School's out! Welcome to the summer vacation episode of Disney Jeopardy! Pack the car, grab the sunscreen, and [laughs] nobody ask if we're there yet.

art.prompt: A sunny summer scene: a vintage station wagon loaded with suitcases and a surfboard on the roof, parked by a sparkling beach with a striped umbrella, a lakeside campfire and canoe in the distance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Backseat Drivers
categories.intro: First, the Disney road trips. [chuckles] Buckle up, and somebody find the map.

art.prompt: An open desert highway at golden hour stretching to the horizon, a vintage gas station with a neon-free sign, a road map spread on a car hood, a fuzzy pair of dice hanging from a rearview mirror, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Cars, Lightning McQueen gets stuck in Radiator Springs, a town on this famous old U.S. highway.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Route 66! The Mother Road. [laughs] Radiator Springs is just a little dusty.

clues.clue: In A Goofy Movie, Max is desperate to see this pop superstar in concert in Los Angeles.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Powerline! Max even sneaks onstage to dance with him. [excited] Eye to eye!

clues.clue: Goofy's road trip with Max is supposed to end at Lake Destiny in this state.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Idaho! Goofy's dream fishing trip. [chuckles] Max had other plans.

clues.clue: In Pixar's Onward, brothers Ian and Barley go on their quest in this rusty purple van.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Guinevere! A noble steed with a unicorn on the side. [laughs] Rest in pieces, Guinevere.

clues.clue: In Cars, Radiator Springs was forgotten after traffic shifted to this interstate, which bypassed the town.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Interstate 40! It shaved ten minutes off the drive. [sighs] And it nearly wiped a town off the map.

categories.title: Camp Counselor
categories.intro: Next, summer camp! [excited] Bug spray, bunk beds, and the occasional twin swap.

art.prompt: A rustic summer camp by a misty lake: wooden cabins, a canoe dock, a crackling campfire with marshmallows on sticks, a flagpole and a row of bunk beds visible through an open cabin door, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In The Parent Trap, twins Hallie and Annie meet for the first time at this kind of place.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is summer camp! Two girls with the same face, at the same camp. [laughs] What are the odds?

clues.clue: Camp Rock starred Demi Lovato alongside this real-life band of brothers.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Jonas Brothers! [excited] Joe played heartthrob Shane Gray.

clues.clue: The Parent Trap's Camp Walden is in this New England state.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Maine! Lakes, pine trees and a whole lot of pranks. [chuckles]

clues.clue: This 1998 Disney Channel reality series followed real kids at a summer camp in Maine.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bug Juice! Named for camp's famously sugary fruit drink. [laughs] Reality TV, with mosquitoes.

clues.clue: In 1995's Heavyweights, this actor plays fitness-crazed camp owner Tony Perkis.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ben Stiller! Perkis turns a cozy camp into a boot camp. [laughs] Nobody touches the candy stash.

categories.title: Surf and Sand Cinema
categories.intro: Now, the beach movies! [excited] Grab a board, paddle out, and watch for sea monsters.

art.prompt: A sunny cove with turquoise waves and a sandy beach, a surfboard stuck in the sand, a beach towel and picnic basket, a little seaside village of pastel houses on a cliff in the distance, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Luca, the young sea monsters turn into these whenever they're dry on land.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is humans! One splash and the scales come right back. [chuckles] Tricky on a rainy day.

clues.clue: In Lilo & Stitch, Stitch is officially this numbered experiment.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Experiment 626! [laughs] Built to destroy, and he ends up loving Elvis.

clues.clue: In Luca, Luca and Alberto dream of owning this Italian scooter.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is a Vespa! [excited] Silenzio, Bruno!

clues.clue: Lilo & Stitch is set on this Hawaiian island, known as the Garden Isle.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kauai! [sighs] Beautiful. Even with a blue alien running loose.

clues.clue: In Teen Beach Movie, Brady and McKenzie surf right into this 1962 beach musical.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Wet Side Story! Surfers versus bikers. [laughs] And a lot of spontaneous singing.

categories.title: Splash Zone
categories.intro: Picture time! Every photo is a real Disney spot for a summer splash. [excited] Towels ready?

art.prompt: A sunny water park and lakeside resort collage with no people: a snowcapped mountain with water slides, a wave pool, wooden cabins under pine trees, a tropical lagoon pool with a shipwreck slide, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Legend says this snowy-looking Walt Disney World water park was a failed resort for this winter sport.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is skiing! A freak snowstorm hit Florida, then melted. [laughs] So now it's Blizzard Beach, with a chairlift to the slides.

clues.clue: Name this Walt Disney World water park, where legend says a storm tossed boats all over the place.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Typhoon Lagoon! [gasps] One shrimp boat landed right on top of the mountain.

source.author: Chad Sparkes from Kissimmee,Florida, United States

clues.clue: At this campground, guests can roast marshmallows and sing with these two chipmunks at a nightly campfire.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chip 'n' Dale! Their campfire sing-along is at Fort Wilderness. [chuckles] Bring your own marshmallows.

clues.clue: Aulani, whose name means 'messenger of a chief,' is a Disney resort on this Hawaiian island.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Oahu! It's on the Ko Olina coast. [excited] Aloha, vacation!

clues.clue: This sand-bottom pool with a shipwreck slide is shared by Disney's Yacht Club and this sister resort.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disney's Beach Club Resort! The pool is called Stormalong Bay. [laughs] Good luck getting the kids out.

categories.title: Wish You Were Here
categories.intro: Finally, postcards from Disney destinations. I name the trip, you name the place. [chuckles]

art.prompt: A spread of blank vintage postcards and travel stamps on a wooden table, a pair of sunglasses, a seashell, a tiny toy airplane and a compass, sunlight streaming in, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Up, Carl and Russell travel by floating house to this South American waterfall.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Paradise Falls! [laughs] Ten thousand balloons. Zero parking problems.

clues.clue: In Finding Nemo, Marlin swims across the ocean to this Australian city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sydney! P. Sherman, 42 Wallaby Way. [excited] Everybody say it with me.

clues.clue: In The Lizzie McGuire Movie, Lizzie's class trip takes her to this city, where she's mistaken for a pop star.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Rome! [excited] This is what dreams are made of!

clues.clue: In 1977, Herbie the Love Bug raced in this Monaco city.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Monte Carlo! Herbie Goes to Monte Carlo. [chuckles] He even falls in love with a blue car.

clues.clue: In Disney's 1960 Swiss Family Robinson, the family was sailing to this colony when they were shipwrecked.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is New Guinea! They were fleeing Napoleon. [laughs] They got an island and a treehouse instead.
